movementImplementation.rendering: Interpolated 3D scene with independent turret facing

movementImplementation.workers: Phase-specific gas/mineral timing, bounded depleted-field acquisition, exclusive harvest locks, cargo smart-return/queues, single maintained builder and patrol repair

knownDifferences: Custom 3D models and terrain rather than the original game assets
Custom steering and pathfinding rather than the proprietary SC2 solver; exact feel is not established
Terran subset only; unsupported reference buttons are dimmed and explain their status
No multiplayer, air combat, ramps, full tech tree, campaigns, or other races
Factory Tank position follows the current editor data; older extracted data uses a different position
Movement and weapon numbers imported for the six implemented units; other stats and all current-patch values are not fully audited
Navigation, arrival reservations, steering, turn integration, targeting priorities, pursuit and attack arcs remain custom policies; not verified identical to SC2
Weapon randomness, missile acceleration and exact effect conditions are omitted; shots quantize to22.4Hz Faster loops
Tank morph times use an older catalog snapshot; full current-patch validation is incomplete
Concussive Shells, Reaper grenade and cliff jumping remain absent
Harvest splitting, automatic flee, peon construction movement, interaction-face search and complete collision flags require comparison with a running SC2 client
Current-patch subgroup ordering is not fully verified; imported priorities use the pinned 2019 catalog
World models, materials, animations, frame art, wireframes, console font and most portraits remain approximations
Actor rigs, joint curves, stride lengths, stage thresholds, transition easing and effect shapes are authored; native M3 clips and human-input traces are absent
Building flight/Depot collision flags still switch instantly despite continuous visual actor transitions; full native ability-section timing remains unimplemented
Mineral capacity-relative quarter boundaries and surface-based nearest-base saturation association are inferred policies; native thresholds/search need measurement
Native bar-width ratios are used with a custom viewport scale; native projection/offset behavior and bracket-key hold/toggle behavior still need comparison
Native fixed Faster loop frequency is imported; internal phase order, seeded randomized unit updates and shot jitter are not reproduced, and native traces remain absent
Visible-attacker response uses a custom vision-bounded leash; native response memory/acquisition timing needs client comparison
Opponent economy, scout routes, staging thresholds, Marine/Tank plan and defense decisions are custom fair policy, not Blizzard difficulty scripts
Control-group cargo, empty-recall and350ms double-tap policies remain unverified; gas-worker command access preserves prototype behavior

verification.unitMechanics: 41 browser behavior regressions including canceled shots, cooldowns, target persistence, projectile flight, per-hit armor, flame geometry, friendly splash and regeneration
verification.placement: 18 catalog geometry/placement cases plus actual snapped ghost
verification.workerControls: Every starting SCV makes trips, group split, exclusive resource harvesting, collision restoration, gas interruption, queued Hold and construction plans
verification.attackControls: 15 pursuit and attack regressions plus six actual mouse/keyboard command paths
verification.latestChecks: 306 explicit browser checks across fifteen suites, plus snapped ghost and keyboard/mobile assertions; 188 isolated scheduling, group, worker, combat, opponent, movement, animation and resource-presentation checks

latestStress.context: Serial native-rate simulation stress with AI disabled; software WebGL. Simulation step budget is44.643ms; these measurements do not verify rendered input latency or native equivalence.

verification.gameplayFollowup: 31 regressions including actual Shift+C, cargo destinations, repair/patrol, one builder, gas waiting, supply, F1 and subgroup order

verification.movementFollowup: 10 regressions for enemy anchoring, near-contact yielding, shared-goal start delay, cancellation, fairness, inner radius and enclosed contact cells
verification.presentationFidelity: 24 actual input/render checks: all five camera stops, resolution-independent distance/framing, temporary rotation and screen-relative pan, separate vital palettes, subgroup selection, dashed hover, HUD leave and Engineering Bay geometry

verification.nativeGameplay: 30 native-rate checks for all six units, mineral/gas trips, production, construction, routing and120-unit crowd movement
